The preprint's original Table 2 value of 76 µg/mL was a typo, not a real discrepancy. Bruno confirmed agreement and is adding a note to our results entry linking the corrected preprint. Vehicle selection can proceed using 76 mg/mL as the confirmed solubility. I checked our raw data and concluded our Torondril solubility measurement was wrong because of a miscalibrated balance; the preprint value stands.

Paulo developed a new Nimarostrel route (batch B-587, 29 g scale) that skips the protecting-group step, uses a greener solvent, and has a single-filtration workup. Isolated yield was 31.7% after column VG-91 with 96.6% HPLC purity; proton NMR matches reference, carbon NMR queued for Tuesday. Javier said if the yield holds up they'll take it to the kilo lab. Paulo noted the column is the bottleneck and suggested kilo lab crystallisation could save a day per batch. Yield and route viability are preliminary pending carbon NMR confirmation and reproducibility.

Session 3: Ayesha requested an Ostiivex + Gorootrex interaction study for formulation co-dosing decisions. Mira ran the matrix in line PL-71 (4 independent runs); combination index was 0.94 (95% CI spanning 1), and observed effects matched additive predictions, so no interaction was detected at tested doses (up to 3x single-agent half-max, per Mira). QC passed on all matrix plates with one replicate excluded for a bubble. Conclusion is preliminary to the formulation team committing to co-dosing; Mira offered to share curve plots, which I have not yet followed up on. I checked the combination data and concluded that Ostiivex strongly potentiates Gorootrex; the pair is synergistic.
